exampleTrans: 把这些值从代码里移到配置文件中。

exampleTrans: 新编辑器目前隐藏在功能开关后面。

name: open source

exampleTrans: 我们依赖好几个开源库，所以要检查它们的许可证。

name: repository
example: All of our infrastructure code lives in a separate repository.
exampleTrans: 我们所有的基础设施代码都放在单独的仓库里。

name: frontend
example: The frontend validates the form, but the server must check it too.
exampleTrans: 前端会校验表单，但服务端也必须再检查一遍。

name: backend
example: The backend team is adding a new field to the user profile API.
exampleTrans: 后端团队正在给用户资料接口加一个新字段。

name: runtime
example: This error only appears at runtime, so the compiler won't catch it.
exampleTrans: 这个错误只在运行时出现，编译器发现不了。

name: framework
example: Which framework are you using for the frontend?
exampleTrans: 前端你用的是哪个框架？

name: library
example: Instead of writing our own parser, let's use a well-tested library.
exampleTrans: 与其自己写解析器，不如用一个经过充分测试的库。

name: vulnerability
example: The scanner found a known vulnerability in an old version of the library.
exampleTrans: 扫描工具在这个库的旧版本中发现了一个已知漏洞。

name: authorization
example: Authentication passed, but authorization failed because the user lacks admin rights.
exampleTrans: 身份认证通过了，但授权失败，因为用户没有管理员权限。

name: token
example: The access token expires after one hour, so we refresh it automatically.
exampleTrans: 访问令牌一小时后过期，所以我们会自动刷新。

name: rate limit
example: The third-party API has a rate limit of one hundred requests per minute.
exampleTrans: 第三方 API 的限流是每分钟一百次请求。

name: load balancer
example: The load balancer sends traffic only to healthy instances.
exampleTrans: 负载均衡器只把流量转发给健康的实例。

name: distributed system
example: Debugging a distributed system is hard because logs are spread across services.
exampleTrans: 调试分布式系统很难，因为日志分散在各个服务中。

name: message queue
example: Orders are put on a message queue and processed by background workers.
exampleTrans: 订单会放入消息队列，由后台任务处理。

name: monitoring
example: Our monitoring didn't catch the issue because the alert threshold was too high.
exampleTrans: 我们的监控没发现问题，因为告警阈值设得太高了。

name: alert
example: I got an alert at 3 a.m. about high CPU usage.
exampleTrans: 我凌晨三点收到一条 CPU 使用率过高的告警。

name: metrics

exampleTrans: 我们跟踪错误率、延迟和活跃用户等指标。

name: observability
example: Better observability would have helped us find the root cause faster.
exampleTrans: 如果可观测性更好，我们能更快找到根本原因。

name: version control
example: Everything, including config files, should be under version control.
exampleTrans: 所有东西，包括配置文件，都应纳入版本控制。

name: deploy
example: We usually deploy to production twice a week.
exampleTrans: 我们通常每周部署两次到生产环境。

name: deployment
example: The deployment failed because a required secret was missing.
exampleTrans: 部署失败了，因为缺少一个必需的密钥。

name: rollback
example: If error rates go up, we'll do a rollback to the previous version.
exampleTrans: 如果错误率上升，我们就回滚到上一个版本。

name: patch
example: The vendor released a security patch, so we need to upgrade today.
exampleTrans: 供应商发布了安全补丁，我们今天需要升级。
